intro.text: An ardent and Soulcaster in Kholinar who, with her sister, secretly makes food for the Wall Guard for Azure.

items.text: During the siege, screamers could sense fabrials, so the city's Soulcasters couldn't feed the people. Azure kept a hidden set of chambers in the city wall, safe from the screamers, where each night she cut blocks of stone with her Shardblade for Ithi and her sister to Soulcast into food for the Wall Guard.

appearance.text: A middle-aged or older woman with vines that seem to grow beneath her skin, out of her eyes and down her face, from her Soulcasting. She wears a Soulcaster fabrial on her hand, powered by large emeralds.
